newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Beijing Ent holds strong, trade active.
newsitem.headline: Beijing Ent holds strong, trade active.

text.p: Shares in Beijing Enterprises Holdings Ltd held strong on Friday morning and were being actively traded on their second day of trade on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.
The stock was up HK$1.50 at HK$41.70 after trading in a range of HK$40.00 to HK$41.80. Mid-morning volume was 114.25 million shares.
The shares were issued at HK$12.48 each and made their debut on Thursday, closing at HK$40.20.

Brokers said some investors were locking in their hefty profits but others were keen to buy around HK$40.00. "It will probably stay around the HK$40 level for a while. It has gone up three times already," said Antony Mak, sales director Vickers Ballas.
